Studies try out different features and ideas before they are released to all Firefox users. Using your feedback, we can make more informed decisions based on what you actually need.

__TOC__

=How do I participate?=
The first step is confirming that the {for not fx151}'''Install and run studies'''{/for}{for fx151}'''Allow Firefox to run feature studies'''{/for} setting is checked (see instructions below). When a study is available, you will automatically be enrolled if you meet the criteria. There will be occasions where we might prompt you for participation first. This will happen when a particular study needs to collect data that is not covered by default data collection policy. In these situations you'll see a complete disclosure of the data being collected in the study before you make the decision to participate.

When the study ends, Studies will be disabled but you will be able to see it so you have a record of what studies you've participated in.

=How do I see the studies I'm in?=
To see the studies you're participating in, type '''about:studies''' into your address bar.

You'll also see studies you've participated in the past.

=How do I opt out?=
==To opt out of a specific study==
#Type '''about:studies''' into your address bar to see a list of your studies.
#Click the {button Remove} button next to the study you want to opt out of.

==To opt out of all studies==
#[[T:optionspreferences]]
#Select the {for not fx152}{menu Privacy & Security}{/for}{for fx152}{menu Permissions and data}{/for} panel.
#Go down to the {for not fx151}'''Firefox Data Collection and Use'''{/for}{for fx151}'''Firefox data collection and use'''{/for} section.
#Remove the check mark next to {for not fx151}'''Install and run studies'''{/for}{for fx151}'''Allow Firefox to run feature studies'''{/for}.
#;{for not fx148}[[Image:Fx140esrDataCollection]]{/for}{for =fx148, =fx149, =fx150}[[Image:Fx148DataCollection]]{/for}{for =fx151}[[Image:Fx151DataCollection]]{/for}{for fx152}[[Image:Fx152settings-DataCollection]]{/for}
{note}'''Tip''': You can also get to these settings from the {for mac, linux}{button Update Preferences}{/for}{for win}{button Update Options}{/for} button on the ''about:studies'' page.{/note}
